Patel Head of Department, Electrical Engineering hod.ee.kset@kpgu.ac.in It is my pleasure and honor to welcome you all to the Department of Electrical Engineering at Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Since its inception in 2004, the Krishna Edu Campus has been a premiere engineering institute in Gujarat. The Electrical Engineering department is an integral part of the institute right from the day of commencement. The Electrical Engineering is an evergreen branch of engineering offering white collar profession. Electrical engineers are versatile professionals required across all the industries. An Electrical Engineer is an all-rounder required in all the industries, PSUs, Urban or Rural administrative agencies. The branch is one of the most popular branches for those seeking the government jobs. The latest trends in EV, Battery technologies, Solar, Wind, Industrial Automation, Robotics are offering excellent opportunities to an Electrical Engineer in addition to old and ever popular career options. This has resulted in the department boasting highly proficient electrical engineers among its alumni who are contributing towards building a brighter future for our society and nation. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Applied Electrical Learning 01 The Department of Electrical Engineering of the Krishna School of Emerging Technology and Applied Research (KSET), KPGU Vadodara came into existence in the year 2004. The department has qualified and dedicated faculty members from NITs and other premier Institutes. The department is conducting P.G. program in Electrical Engineering Faculties of the department encourage students for practical learning through their projects and dissertations. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To produce Electrical Engineering graduates with world-class technical skills, capable of contributing as industry experts, entrepreneurs, and researchers 01 To develop excellent technical skills in students. 02 To be inclined towards entrepreneurship, research, and innovation. 03 To instill professional ethics and human values in graduates who are committed to improving society.
